answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the willow funding graph is rebuilt from the sparrow history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 67 bonds yet holds one position, and the horizon report publishes the merged exposure. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 67 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
